LA HABRA HEIGHTS

  FIREWISE USA  ®

  WORKSHOP
Please join us for this valuable workshop to learn
low-cost ideas to reduce wildfire risk to your
home and to ensure the best fire insurance rate
possible. It’s a wonderful opportunity to meet
your neighbors and share ideas. By working
together we can help keep La Habra Heights safe!

Speakers:  8:00 AM
